title: The Note in the Tube
lines: Jane and Pete hike to the lake.
Pete finds a tube in the mud.
A note is in the tube!
The note has a map on it.
The map has nine steps from the pine.
Jane digs and finds a white stone.
Pete rubs it. The stone has a shine.
Jane and Pete take the stone home.

questions.ask: What does Pete find in the mud?
questions.listenFor: A tube with a note in it. If they say just "a note," ask what the note was inside of.

questions.ask: How do Jane and Pete know where to dig?
questions.listenFor: The map on the note tells them nine steps from the pine. Listen for the map or the nine steps.

questions.ask: What do you think the stone is? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. You are listening for imagination plus a clue from the story, like "it shines, so maybe it is a jewel."
